description:
Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.

Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
Runner 0.18.0 is a feature release for macOS and Windows on top of 0.17.2.
New
- Remote access, a private beta. Connect this computer to a Runner account and reach its chats and missions from Runner on your other computers, even on another network. Sessions are encrypted end to end, and Runner's relay only forwards them. The beta is invite-only and available in mainland China for now: request an invite code in the Runner Discord or WeChat user group, linked from Settings → Remote access and Settings → About. Your agents keep running when a connection drops or the desktop app closes. (#836)
- Open another computer from the sidebar. Once signed in, the computer picker in the sidebar lists your account's computers with their online status. Click one to switch this window to it, or Shift-click to open it in a new window. Its projects, tabs, missions and terminals use the same controls as this computer: start, stop, resume, fork, rename and archive chats, split panes, browse that computer's folders for New chat and Start mission, read a mission's feed, answer its questions and message its crew. A green dot shows when a session there needs your input. (#953)
- Pair computers with a PIN. On the computer you want to reach, turn on Allow remote access and set a six-digit PIN in Settings → Remote access; the other computer enters it once to pair. Five failed attempts in a row lock PIN entry until you unlock it. Runner notifies you when a computer pairs, and Revoke, Forget and Reset remote access remove access again. Signing in to the account alone never grants terminal access. (#952)
- Take a terminal back. When another computer controls a tab, the desktop shows Controlled from over it. Choose Take back to return the whole tab to this desktop, with each pane fitted to its own size. (#953)
- Local only. Settings → General → Local only hides Account, Remote access, the account avatar and the computer picker, and stops access from other computers. It is off by default. (#836)
- runner remote in the CLI. Sign in, check status, list and pair computers, read another computer's overview, set the PIN, list and revoke paired devices, or reset this computer's identity from a terminal, including over SSH. Signing in, pairing and setting the PIN need your own interactive terminal; agents inside Runner cannot do them. (#951)
